verdict.rationale: ernd is a corporate charge card that offers cash back and partner perks on AI vendor spend. It is not an AI agent or assistant that would act as an MCP client, so plugging in MCP servers for tool use is a category error for this product type. Nothing in the evidence shows an agent or MCP-client feature that would make this axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
